item.title: Australia's Ampol to buy EV charging operator Evie Networks for $156 million
item.description: Australian fuel retailer Ampol said on Thursday it had agreed to buy electric vehicle charging company Evie Networks for A$225 million ($156.26 million), bolstering its footprint in the fast-growing domestic public EV charging market. Here are some more details:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australian fuel retailer Ampol (ALD.AX) said on Thursday it had agreed to buy electric vehicle charging company Evie Networks for A$225 million ($156.26 million), bolstering its footprint in the fast-growing domestic public EV charging market. Here are some more details: The deal would give Ampol a combined network of about 1,425 charging bays across more than 400 sites. The combined business is expected to achieve annualised earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation of A$30 million, including synergies, within three years of completion. Ampol's unit Ampol Energy has entered into a share sale agreement to acquire 100% of Fast Cities Australia, which operates as Evie Networks. Evie Networks owns 1,031 direct current charging bays across 322 sites in Australia. The deal is expected to complete in the first half of 2027, pending approval from the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC). Shares of Ampol were down 2.4% at A$43.05, as of 0019 GMT, compared with a more than 1% decline in the broader energy sub-index (.AXEJ) . ($1 = 1.4399 Australian dollars)

item.title: South Korea factory growth hits 4-month high as export orders boom, PMI shows
item.description: South Korea's factory activity grew in September at the strongest pace in four months, as export demand hit the fastest pace in 15-1/2 years led by the chip and auto sectors, a survey showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea's factory activity grew in September at the strongest pace in four months, as export demand hit the fastest pace in 15-1/2 years led by the chip and auto sectors, a survey showed on Thursday. The purchasing managers index (PMI), published by S&P Global, stood at 53.9 in September, up from 52.3 in August and the highest since May. The index remained above the 50 mark separating expansion from contraction for a 10th consecutive month. "Both new orders and production growth hit the highest for around five-and-a-half years, with anecdotal evidence often linking the expansions to the combined strength of the semiconductor and automotive sectors," said Usamah Bhatti, economist at S&P Global Market Intelligence. Output rose at the sharpest rate since March 2021, while new orders increased at the fastest since February 2021. New export orders jumped most since March 2011, with notable strength seen in Europe and Asia. Manufacturers' optimism for the year ahead improved to an eight-month high.

item.title: Japan September factory growth slows to 6-month low, PMI shows
item.description: Japan's manufacturing sector expanded at its weakest pace in six months in September as output and new order growth slowed, a business survey showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan's manufacturing sector expanded at its weakest pace in six months in September as output and new order growth slowed, a business survey showed on Thursday. The S&P Global Japan Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) eased to 54.1 in September from 54.9 in August, a survey by S&P Global showed, matching a flash reading. Although it slowed down from the previous month, it marked the ninth consecutive month of expansion. A reading above 50.0 indicates expansion, while below that level signals contraction. "Firms signalled slower increases in output and new orders, as some companies mentioned that clients were adjusting inventories as an earlier period of stock accumulation began to unwind," said Annabel Fiddes, economics associate director at S&P Global Market Intelligence. While production rose strongly, its pace eased to a three-month low. Total new orders similarly increased at a slower rate, with the expansion the weakest in four months after August's multi-year record. Overseas demand remained firmer. New export orders rose for a ninth straight month and the pace of growth was the second-sharpest since January 2018, supported by stronger demand across Asian economies and improved sales to the US. Employment increased for a 22nd consecutive month and the pace stayed close to August's recent high, making it the second-fastest since April 2018. Higher staffing and slower sales growth helped reduce backlog growth to a modest six-month low. Cost pressures remained elevated even as they eased. Input cost inflation slowed to a six-month low, while firms continued to raise selling prices at one of the sharpest rates seen since late 2022. Manufacturers remained optimistic that output would rise over the next 12 months, with sentiment little changed from August and above the long-run average. Firms cited demand related to semiconductors and AI-related technology, though the survey flagged supply disruption, component shortages and rising costs as risks.

item.title: ロシア、ＮＡＴＯに核使用辞さずと警告 バルト海巡り緊張
item.description:
Lili Bayer Mark Trevelyan
[ブリュッセル ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Lili Bayer　Mark Trevelyan

[ブリュッセル ３０日 ロイター] - ロシアは北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）に対し、バルト海に面するロシアの飛び地カリーニングラードを切り離そうとした場合、核兵器の使用も辞さないと警告した。

ロイターが確認したＮＡＴＯ宛ての文書で、ロシアはＮＡＴＯが「直接的な武力衝突の勃発につながる高いリスク」を伴う「危険かつ無謀な路線」を進んでいると非難。これには「ロシアが初期段階からＮＡＴＯ加盟国の意思決定中枢を攻撃する」可能性も含まれるとした。

その上で「ＮＡＴＯ諸国がカリーニングラードをロシアの他の地域から孤立させることを狙った試みに踏み切れば、ロシアは自国領土を防衛するため、核兵器を含む利用可能なあらゆる戦力と能力を行使する用意がある」と警告した。

ＮＡＴＯのルッテ事務総長は、ロシアに対し「われわれは防衛同盟だ。核による威嚇はやめるべきだ。全く不要で、何の役にも立たない」と返答したと明らかにした。

ロイターが確認したロシアの文書への回答で、ＮＡＴＯは「いかなる演習や活動もロシア連邦の領土に脅威を与えるものではない」とも説明。

その上で「われわれはロシア連邦に対し、いわれのないウクライナへの全面侵攻を終わらせるよう求める。加盟国に対する無謀な行動を控え、無責任な核のレトリックをやめるよう強く求める」とした。

ルッテ氏はバルト諸国に対して核兵器が使用されるリスクが現実のものになったかとの質問に対し、「そうではない。プーチン氏（ロシア大統領）はＮＡＴＯに決して勝てないと分かっている。従って、私はそれほど深刻には受け止めていない」と述べた。

今回の非公開の警告に加え、欧州の少なくとも３カ国のロシア大使館は過去３日間に声明を発表し、ＮＡＴＯが軍事演習やカリーニングラードに関わる想定シナリオの策定を通じて緊張を高めていると非難した。

＜誤算のリスク＞

ウィーンを拠点とする核問題アナリストで元ロシア外交官のニコライ・ソコフ氏は、西側諸国がロシアとの直接対立に陥ることなくウクライナ支援を強化し続けることが、ますます困難になっていると指摘した。

同氏によると、今回のロシアの警告は、ウクライナへの武器供与、新たな対ロ制裁、ロシア船舶の臨検、頻繁な軍事演習、カリーニングラード近辺での情報収集飛行といった西側の行動にどう対応するかを巡る議論で、強硬派の影響力が増していることを示している可能性がある。

ソコフ氏は「ロシアはバルト海の封鎖を含め、さらなる行動を予想している。欧州側の計算では戦争に至る一歩手前でも、ロシアにとっては明白な戦争になる。双方が判断を誤るリスクがある」と述べた。

item.title: Ｆ１＝ハース、オコンが今季限りで退団 後任候補にカマラ
item.description: ［３０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のハースは３０日、フランス人ドライバーのエステバン・オコン（３０）が今シーズン限りでチームを離れると発表した。

２０２５年にアルピーヌからハースに移籍したオコンは、今季のドライバーズランキングで１６位。チームメートで１３位のオリバー・ベアマン（英国）とは１３ポイント差となっている。

オコンは交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）で、「さまざまな理由や自分ではコントロールできない要因により、必ずしも簡単ではない状況下だったが、自分のパフォーマンスを誇りに思い、胸を張ってこのプロジェクトから去る」と表明。

「今季はまだ多くのレースが残っており、これまで通り自分自身とチームのために全力を尽くす。私のモチベーションは衰えていないし、勝利への意欲も失っていない。これは決して私のＦ１キャリアの終わりではない」と述べた。

今季１１チーム中７位につけているハースは声明で、オコンの貢献に感謝の意を示した。チームは後任として複数の候補を検討しており、フェラーリの支援を受けるラファエル・カマラ（ブラジル）が有力候補の一人と目されている。

item.title: Great goalie matchup expected as Rangers open at home vs. Lightning
item.description: There is no place for the New York Rangers to go but up as they open their home schedule against the Tampa Bay Lightning on Thursday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: There is no place for the New York Rangers to go but up as they open their home schedule against the Tampa Bay Lightning on Thursday night. Tuesday's contest against the host Boston Bruins looked a lot like the season opener last year for a New York club that finished last in the Eastern Conference. The Rangers watched the Original Six tilt unravel as the home side hit the net three times in 75 seconds late in the third period in a 3-0 win. Captain J.T. Miller said the Rangers knew it would be a tough matchup of elite goaltenders in Igor Shesterkin and Boston's Jeremy Swayman. "It's Game 1. If we had won the game I would be saying the same thing," he said. "We're going to get better as we go here." Latvian defenseman Alberts Smits, the 18-year-old fifth pick of this year's draft, made his NHL debut Tuesday by going minus-1 in 16:54 of ice time. Coach Mike Sullivan became the third American-born mentor to reach 1,000 games. In its opener last season, New York also was blanked, dropping a 3-0 matchup against the visiting Pittsburgh Penguins. The past two seasons have been nightmarish ones for the Rangers, who made it to the conference final three years ago before losing to the eventual Stanley Cup champion Florida Panthers. The Rangers were miserable on home ice last season (14-20-7), going 0-6-1 out of the gate and winless there in the campaign's first full month, in a terrible beginning for a club playing in the world's most famous arena. That led general manager Chris Drury to reshape the roster. Point-producing forwards Artemi Panarin (trade deadline deal) and Vincent Trocheck (offseason move) were dealt, as were Sam Carrick and defenseman Will Borgen. High-scoring Pavel Dorofeyev was brought in from Vegas, while veterans Marcus Pettersson, Oliver Bjorkstrand, Joe Veleno, Sean Durzi and Joonas Korpisalo were also added to the fold. Expectations are a little loftier for Tampa Bay. The club's standout players racked up hardware as high-scoring winger Nikita Kucherov claimed the Hart Trophy, while steadfast goalie Andre Vasilevskiy secured his second Vezina Trophy. Coach Jon Cooper claimed the Jack Adams Award as the top coach. Anthony Cirelli came close to winning the Selke Trophy that is awarded to the league's top defensive forward, finishing second to Montreal's Nick Suzuki. Individual accomplishments aside, futility has defined the Atlantic Division team when the regular season ends. The Lightning have not won a playoff series since the 2022 season, dropping four straight first-round matchups against Toronto, arch rival Florida in consecutive postseasons and Montreal last season on home ice in a Game 7. Bjorkstrand departed for the Rangers via free agency, and Nick Paul and Darren Raddysh went to Toronto. However, forward Ilya Mikheyev (Chicago) and goalie Dennis Hildeby (Toronto) joined the Lightning. John Carlson, a reliable 36-year-old defenseman, will replace Raddysh and quarterback the power play. With training camp unusually short as the league expands to an 84-game season, Carlson arrived before camp. He spent 17 seasons and played 1,159 career games with the Washington Capitals before finishing last season with 16 games for the Anaheim Ducks. "School started early," said Carlson, a right-handed shot. "There were a lot of guys (in camp) over the last month. That was a big plus for me getting familiar with the guys." --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝ロナルド、代表チーム突如離脱 起用巡り監督と確執か
item.description: ［コペンハーゲン ３０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［コペンハーゲン　３０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのポルトガル代表ＦＷクリスティアノ・ロナルド（４１）が３０日、欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）の試合に向けて合宿中の同代表から離脱した。チームは翌日にデンマーク戦を控えており、直前の離脱となった。

ポルトガルは２７日のＮＬでノルウェーに２─１で勝利したが、この試合にロナルドは出場せず。ジョルジェ・ジェズス新監督は途中出場させると話していたが、最後まで起用しなかった。ロナルドはその後２日間チーム練習に参加せず、ジムで個別にトレーニングを行っていた。

ジェズス監督は３０日の練習前記者会見で、ノルウェー戦の一件について「ロナルドは私に怒っていたが、私としてはそれはもう過去のこと」とコメント。ロナルドが練習を拒否したという報道については「拒否していない。彼はきょうの練習に参加する」とし、「ありもしない問題についてクリス（ロナルド）と話すよう言われた」と、トラブルがあったわけではないとした。

しかし、複数のポルトガルメディアは、その会見の直後にロナルドが合宿地を発ったと報道。ロナルドはインスラグラムで「ジェズス監督の会見後、ポルトガルサッカー連盟（ＦＰＦ）のペドロ・プロエンサ会長との話し合いを経て、代表合宿を離れることを決断した」と明かした。

さらに「私は常に代表チームに全力を捧げてきたが、そのチームを去った理由について、そのうちポルトガル国民のみなさんに伝えるつもりだ。今はチームと選手たち全員の幸運を祈る」と述べた。

ＦＰＦもロナルドの離脱を認め、デンマーク戦と４日のノルウェー戦に向けた準備は、このまま残り２４人の選手と続けていくとしている。

item.title: テニス＝ジョコビッチ、2回戦進出で中国ＯＰ30戦無敗 本玉は初戦敗退
item.description: ［北京 ３０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［北京　３０日　ロイター］ - テニスの中国オープン（ＯＰ）は３０日、北京で試合を行い、男子シングルス１回戦では第６シードのノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）がヌーノ・ボルヘス（ポルトガル）に勝利し、２回戦に進出した。

１１年ぶりに中国ＯＰに復帰したジョコビッチは、６─３、７─６でストレート勝ち。同大会での通算成績を３０勝無敗とした。

同大会最多６回の優勝を誇り、その更新を目指す３９歳のジョコビッチは「第２セットで相手のプレーが良くなり、フレッシュな状態を保つことに少し苦労した。それでも、素晴らしいタイブレークを戦い抜いてストレートで試合を決めることができたので、とても満足している」と述べた。２回戦では地元のブ・ユンチャオケテ（中国）と対戦する。

第２シードのフェリックス・オジェアリアシム（カナダ）は、ロシア出身のカレン・ハチャノフに３─６、３─６のストレートで敗れた。

女子シングルス１回戦では、本玉真唯がケイティー・ボールター（英国）に３─６、４─６のストレート負けを喫し、敗退した。

item.title: Second judge blocks Trump's $100,000 fee for new H-1B worker visas
item.description: A second federal judge on Wednesday blocked an unprecedented $100,000 fee that US President Donald Trump has imposed on new H-1B visas for highly skilled foreign workers.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: A second federal judge on Wednesday blocked an unprecedented $100,000 fee that US President Donald Trump has imposed on new H-1B visas for highly skilled foreign workers. US District Judge Haywood Gilliam in Oakland, California, ruled that US Citizenship and Immigration Services and the State Department failed to follow necessary rule-making processes before implementing Trump's fee. Gilliam, appointed by then-President Barack Obama, a Democrat, granted a request by a coalition of unions, employers and nonprofits to block the agencies from implementing Trump's fee pending the outcome of a [USN:L2N3VK0SM TEXT:"lawsuit they filed"] in October. The fee was temporarily blocked in June by a federal judge in Boston, ruling in a separate case brought by 20 states. A Boston-based appeals court in July [USN:L6N43Q1BA TEXT:"declined to pause"] that decision. The Department of Homeland Security in August [USN:L1N44N0CI TEXT:"moved to adopt a permanent fee"] of about $103,000 that, when finalized, will likely be challenged in court. But that will involve different legal issues than lawsuits over the fee set by Trump. These suits have focused on the president's power to set such a fee unilaterally. The $100,000 fee was originally set to expire September 21 but Trump, a Republican, [USN:L1N45A102 TEXT:"recently extended it"] for another year. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Democracy Forward, a left-leaning legal group that represents the plaintiffs, applauded the ruling in a statement. "Today’s decision ... protects a system that was thrown into chaos overnight," said Steve Bressler, a lawyer with the group. The US Chamber of Commerce, the country's largest business lobbying group, has [USN:L2N3VX0U3 TEXT:"filed a third lawsuit"] challenging the fee. The chamber is appealing a judge's decision rejecting its claims that Trump had no authority to set the fee. The H-1B program allows US employers to hire foreign workers with training in specialty fields. Technology companies in particular [USN:L2N3VA0NE TEXT:"rely heavily"] on workers who receive H-1B visas. The program offers 65,000 visas annually, with another 20,000 visas for workers with advanced degrees, approved for three to six years. Trump's order sharply raised the cost of obtaining H-1B visas, which had typically come with about $2,000 to $5,000 in fees, depending on various factors. In imposing the fee, Trump invoked the president's power under federal immigration law to restrict the entry of certain foreign nationals that would be detrimental to US interests. He said businesses had abused the H-1B program and replaced American workers with cheaper foreign labor. The Trump administration has also [USN:L1N3XA00F TEXT:"ordered enhanced vetting"] of H-1B applicants and proposed a new visa selection process that would favor higher-skilled and better-paid workers.

item.title: South Korea September exports rise 83.5% y/y to monthly record
item.description: South Korea's exports jumped 83.5% in September from a year earlier to post a record monthly high, customs data showed on Thursday. Semiconductor shipments, fuelled by global spending on artificial intelligence, also set a record.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea's exports jumped 83.5% in September from a year earlier to post a record monthly high, customs data showed on Thursday. Semiconductor shipments, fuelled by global spending on artificial intelligence, also set a record. Data released by the customs office on Thursday showed outbound shipments outstripped market [USN:L1N45K03J TEXT:"expectations"] of a 62.0% increase, marking the country’s 16th consecutive month of export growth. Average exports per working day jumped by 104.9% compared to the previous year. The surging growth was anchored by a historic peak in semiconductor shipments, which continue to serve as the backbone of the global AI infrastructure build-out. Imports climbed 26.0% year-on-year, outpacing the 21.5% forecast. This resulted in a provisional trade surplus of $49.85 billion, up from $34.79 billion in August.

item.title: South Korea ordered to pay Elliott $48.49 million in Samsung merger case
item.description: South Korea has been ordered to pay US hedge fund Elliott about $48.49 million plus interest after a tribunal ruled the government's involvement in the 2015 merger of Samsung C&T and Cheil Industries was causally linked to Elliott's losses, Seoul's Justice Ministry said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea has been ordered to pay US hedge fund Elliott about $48.49 million plus interest after a tribunal ruled the government's involvement in the 2015 merger of Samsung C&T and Cheil Industries was causally linked to Elliott's losses, Seoul's Justice Ministry said on Thursday. The remand tribunal upheld the same damages award as the original arbitration, according to the ministry.

item.title: Comité Autónomo Regla Fiscal (CARF) proyecta mayor déficit fiscal para Colombia y menor crecimiento
item.description: Colombia registraría un déficit total de 7,8% del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB) en 2026 y de 9,5% del PIB en 2027, superiores a las proyecciones del Gobierno, estimó un informe del Comité Autónomo de la Regla Fiscal (CARF) divulgado el miércoles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colombia registraría un déficit total de 7,8% del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB) en 2026 y de 9,5% del PIB en 2027, superiores a las proyecciones del Gobierno, estimó un informe del Comité Autónomo de la Regla Fiscal (CARF) divulgado el miércoles. El Gobierno del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella, que se posesionó en agosto, estimó un déficit fiscal de 7,2% para 2026 y 9,4% para 2027. El CARF proyectó un crecimiento del PIB de 2,5% en 2026 y 1,8% en 2027. Las estimaciones están por debajo del crecimiento de 2,6% del PIB esperado por el Gobierno para este año y de 2,2% para 2027. El CARF es un organismo independiente que evalúa, alerta y hace seguimiento para que Colombia mantenga unas finanzas públicas responsables, aunque sus conceptos son no vinculantes ni obligatorios para el Gobierno. La deuda neta de Colombia llegaría a 60,2% del PIB en 2026 y 67,4% en 2027. Sin ajustes estructurales, la deuda alcanzaría 91,2% del PIB en 2030, según el CARF. "Se requiere un ajuste promedio del balance primario de 6,4% del PIB entre 2028-2030 para cumplir la regla fiscal y garantizar sostenibilidad", aseguró el informe. El presidente De La Espriella reiteró el domingo en la noche en una alocución que la situación fiscal del país es crítica y culpó al Gobierno de su antecesor, el izquierdista Gustavo Petro, del deterioro que, según dijo, se originó en la corrupción y el derroche de los recursos. El mandatario no presentó pruebas de su acusación. Colombia inició conversaciones con el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para buscar un eventual acuerdo que permita poner en orden sus finanzas. El Gobierno aumentará su endeudamiento en más de 10.500 millones de dólares adicionales este año y para 2027 más que se duplicará a 71.660 millones de dólares, desde los 32.976 millones de dólares previstos antes. Colombia atraviesa dificultades fiscales en medio de un menor recaudo tributario, un gasto ampliado durante el anterior Gobierno y una inflación persistente. De La Espriella ha prometido medidas de austeridad de gran alcance para recortar el gasto, pero tendrán que ser aprobadas por el Congreso.

item.title: 日経平均は続伸で寄り付く、半導体株が買い優勢 直近高値を上回る
item.description: [東京 １日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．５３％（３５２円８０銭）高の６万７１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は続伸で寄り付く、半導体株が買い優勢　直近高値を上回る 9:18 配信

写真は4月6日、東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 １日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．５３％（３５２円８０銭）高の６万７１０６円５２銭と、続伸してスタートした。米マイクロン・テクノロジーの予想を上回る決算を好感し、半導体関連株が買い優勢となり、指数を押し上げている。日経平均は６万７０００円を回復するとともに、９月２８日に付けた直近の戻り高値６万７０３４円７４銭を上回った。

個別では、東京エレクトロンが買い気配で始まったほか、アドバンテスト、ソフトバンクグループなどもしっかり。ファーストリテイリングも小高いが、トヨタ自動車がさえず、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループなど銀行株も軟調な始まりとなった。

item.title: BOJ debated need for more rate hikes at September meeting, summary shows
item.description: Some Bank of Japan policymakers saw the need to accelerate the pace of interest rate hikes or bring them closer to the central bank's "goal" soon, a summary of opinions at its September meeting showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: Some Bank of Japan policymakers saw the need to accelerate the pace of interest rate hikes or bring them closer to the central bank's "goal" soon, a summary of opinions at its September meeting showed on Thursday. Most of the opinions cited the need for followthrough of September's rate hike with further increases in borrowing costs as inflationary pressure mounts. "If signs of an upward deviation in prices are observed, the Bank will need to accelerate the pace of rate hikes," one member was quoted as saying. "It is desirable for the Bank to bring the policy interest rate closer to the approximate goal relatively soon" to allow it scope to respond to unexpected developments in the economy, another opinion showed. Several opinions also pointed out that underlying inflation had reached, or was close to hitting, the BOJ's target of 2%. One said while the BOJ did not need to take hasty action, it should raise rates to prevent excessive and persistent price rises with underlying inflation seen reaching 2% before long. At its [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"September meet"], the BOJ raised interest rates to a 31-year high, with the central bank's governor signalling a new phase focused on keeping inflation from overshooting its target, opening the door to further rate hikes.

item.title: Jessica Shepard wins Most Improved Player award in close vote
item.description: After five seasons with the Minnesota Lynx, unrestricted free agent Jessica Shepard signed with the Dallas Wings in April.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: After five seasons with the Minnesota Lynx, unrestricted free agent Jessica Shepard signed with the Dallas Wings in April. The move paid immediate dividends for the Wings and Shepard, who was named the WNBA's Most Improved Player on Wednesday after leading the league with six triple-doubles. Shepard, 30, edged Washington Mystics center Shakira Austin for the award, receiving 29 votes from a national panel of sportswriters and broadcasters. Austin earned 25 votes while Portland Fire guard Carla Leite was a distant third with 11 votes. Toronto's Marina Mabrey (4), Seattle's Dominique Malonga (3) and Los Angeles' Rae Burrell (2) also received votes. Shepard, who never averaged more than 8.1 points, 5.4 rebounds or 3.5 assists per game in any season with Minnesota, produced 14.5 points, 11.1 rebounds and 5.3 assists for the Wings while helping the franchise post its highest winning percentage (.614) since the Detroit Shock won the 2008 championship. Shepard and Atlanta Dream forward Angel Reese (16.4 ppg, 12.1 rpg) were the only players to average a double-double this season. Shepard started 42 games and ranked second in the league in rebounds, fifth in field-goal accuracy (57.5%) and 11th in assists per contest. The Notre Dame product's six triple-doubles tied for the second-most in a season in WNBA history. She added 25 double-doubles, the fourth-most in a WNBA season. Reese set a single-season WNBA record with 521 rebounds in 2026 and Shepard amassed the second-most at 467. A first-time WNBA All-Star, Shepard was voted a starter for the game. In her fifth season with Washington, the 26-year-old Austin posted career bests in scoring (17.0 ppg), rebounding (9.5 rpg), assists (2.6 per game), blocks (1.2 per game) and 3-point percentage (.315). Both Shepard and Austin led their respective teams to playoff berths after two-year absences. --Field Level Media

item.title: Presupuesto de Chile para 2027 crecerá 1,5% con foco en crecimiento y seguridad: Kast
item.description: El presupuesto de Chile para 2027 crecerá un 1,5% con énfasis en crecimiento y seguridad, dijo el miércoles el presidente José Antonio Kast.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presupuesto de Chile para 2027 crecerá un 1,5% con énfasis en crecimiento y seguridad, dijo el miércoles el presidente José Antonio Kast. Tras su ingreso más temprano en la jornada, el Congreso tiene 60 días para estudiar, ajustar y aprobar el proyecto de ley de Presupuesto y endeudamiento para el próximo año. "El Presupuesto 2027 crece un 1,5% respecto de este año y, al mismo tiempo, cumple con nuestro compromiso fiscal. Cada peso bien cuidado es una oportunidad para Chile. Cada peso bien invertido puede cambiar muchas vidas", dijo en una transmisión de radio y televisión. "Se esperaba que el gasto creciera entre 0% y 1%. Decidimos hacer un esfuerzo adicional de medio punto para acelerar la reactivación, la inversión y el empleo", agregó. El mandatario nombró el crecimiento y la seguridad como las dos primeras prioridades del proyecto y especificó que el gasto en seguridad crecerá un 9,1% interanual, mientras que en salud subirá un 4,7%. Además urgió al Congreso a buscar acuerdos que permitan sacar adelante la iniciativa. "Les pido que el debate sea exigente, pero que no sea desde una trinchera", acotó. El presupuesto viene en momentos en que la economía chilena enfrenta un mercado laboral debilitado. Kast dijo que actualmente 980.000 personas buscan trabajo y que el desempleo se ha mantenido por encima del 8% por más de tres años y medio.

item.title: Japan business mood improves, tankan survey shows
item.description: Japanese business confidence improved in the three months to September, a quarterly central bank survey showed on Thursday, suggesting the economy was weathering the hit from the Middle East conflict and bolstering the case for more rate hikes.
item.dc:creator: Makiko Yamazaki
item.content:encoded: Japanese business confidence improved in the three months to September, a quarterly central bank survey showed on Thursday, suggesting the economy was weathering the hit from the Middle East conflict and bolstering the case for more rate hikes. The data will be among factors affecting the Bank of Japan's quarterly growth and inflation forecasts due later this month, which will offer clues on how soon it could raise interest rates again after a hike in September. The headline index measuring big manufacturers' business sentiment improved to +24 in September from +22 in June, the BOJ's "tankan" survey showed, compared with market forecasts for a reading of +25. An index measuring big non-manufacturers' sentiment stood at +35 after a +37 reading in June. It compared with market forecasts for +36. Companies expect inflation to hit 2.6% three years from now and 2.5% five years from now, the tankan showed, a sign firms see inflation staying well above the BOJ's 2% target for a prolonged period. The BOJ raised interest rates to a 31-year high [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"last month"], with its governor signalling the central bank has entered a new phase focused on preventing inflation from overshooting its target, opening the door to further rate hikes.

Kentaro Sugiyama
[東京 １日 ロイター] - 日銀が１日に発表した９月短観は、大企業・製造業の業...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
大企業・製造業の業況判断ＤＩはプラス24、6期連続で改善　非製造業は5期ぶり悪化＝9月日銀短観 9:11 配信

写真は東京港の貨物コンテナと日本国旗。2月16日撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 １日 ロイター] -  日銀が１日に発表した９月短観は、大企業・製造業の業況判断指数（ＤＩ）がプラス２４と、６期連続で改善した。２０１８年３月以来の高水準。大企業・非製造業の業況判断ＤＩはプラス３５と、５期ぶりに悪化し、２５年１２月以来の水準となった。

大企業・製造業の業況判断ＤＩは、前回６月調査から２ポイント改善。先行き判断ＤＩはプラス２１で、３ポイントの悪化を見込む。

大企業・非製造業ＤＩは６月調査から２ポイント悪化。先行き判断ＤＩはプラス３０と、５ポイントの悪化を見込む。

ロイターが集計した民間調査機関の予測によると、業況判断ＤＩの予測中央値は、大企業・製造業がプラス２５、大企業・非製造業はプラス３６だった。

事業計画の前提となる想定為替レート（全規模・全産業）は、２６年度通期で１ドル＝１５４．２３円と、前回調査から１．６６円円安方向に修正された。

調査期間は８月２６日から９月３０日。回収基準日の９月９日までに約７割が回答した。

＊この記事はこの後更新します。

item.title: Felt like ‘massive turbulence’: Passengers recount chaos on flydubai flight
item.description: The plane, where a co-pilot stabbed his colleague, dropped more than 4,260m in 30 seconds, according to flight-tracking website Flightradar24.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Felt like ‘massive turbulence’: Passengers recount chaos on flydubai flight

The plane, where a co-pilot stabbed his colleague, dropped more than 4,260m in 30 seconds, according to flight-tracking website Flightradar24.

Passengers who were on the FlyDubai aircraft bound for Israel from the United Arab Emirates, which was diverted to Saudi Arabia following an emergency signal, arrive at the Ben Gurion International Airport, in Lod, near Tel Aviv, Israel, on Sep 30, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Ammar Awad)

JERUSALEM: When flydubai flight FZ1073 suddenly plunged from over 30,000 feet (9,100m) on Wednesday (Sep 30), passenger Almog Italie said it felt like the plane was passing through "massive turbulence" before he realised a life-or-death struggle had unfolded in the cockpit. Italie described passengers running to the front of the cabin and commotion in front of the cockpit, where Israel i officials said the co-pilot had stabbed the captain to try to crash the plane flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv with more than 170 Israel is on board. "It was dropping like for 20, 30 seconds, and then balanced, and then started dropping again, and balanced again, and then we saw that (there) are people in the front, directly (in front of ) the cockpit," he told Reuters.  "Crew members and passengers from the front of the airplane took over and got control of the two pilots." Doron Spielman, a spokesperson for the Israel i prime minister’s office, said the wounded captain, bloodied and lying on the floor, had drawn on "the last moments of his energy" to click open the release on the cockpit door. "At that moment, some of the passengers that realised something was happening raced forward, entered the pilot's cabin. They saw the injured pilot on the ground, and the other … the attacking pilot was standing over the control panel, bashing the control panel," he said. A passenger subdued the attacker, he said. A video filmed on board and verified by Reuters captured the aftermath. In it, two wounded men are seen lying on the floor, both bloodied. A voice speaking in Hebrew off camera says one of them is the pilot "they tried to murder". A voice off camera identifies the other as the attacker, lying on his side with three stripes on his epaulette, indicating that he is a co-pilot. "We were attacked now, on this airplane, they tried to murder the pilot, and we took control of the team/staff," a man in a black shirt with blood on his face says. Another man says: "We're standing here, no one is going to pass through the pilot's door."

RESERVE CREW A reserve flydubai crew that had been on board took control of the plane and landed it safely at Tabuk Airport, a flydubai spokesperson said. A playback of the flight posted on flight-tracking website Flightradar24 showed the plane cruising at 34,000 feet heading westwards over Saudi Arabia when it dropped more than 14,000 feet in 30 seconds, before veering northwest. It briefly crossed into Jordan, then returned to Saudi airspace and flew to Tabuk. Israel i Defense Minister Israel Katz said the attempted attack "was thwarted solely thanks to the heroism of several Israel i passengers who stormed the cockpit, subdued the terrorist, and - with their own hands - restored control of the aircraft to an additional flight crew present on board". "According to our preliminary information, the terrorist had a single objective: to crash the plane," he said in a statement. Flydubai said in a statement that the underlying reasons for the event remained unknown and warned against "premature speculation". Italie said the reserve crew "took over the airplane and balanced it". "It was quite scary, but not for long. Most of the passengers kept calm and were very supportive to each other. And when then we landed in Saudi Arabia, which we got a very very warm welcome with a lot of medical staff and food and anything we needed," he said.

Related:

Flydubai 'terrorist' wanted to crash plane, kill Israelis: Security minister

Passengers foil bid to crash Dubai-Tel Aviv flight, Israel says, after co-pilot stabs pilot

Source: Reuters/rl

item.title: トランプ氏、経済実績の説明「下手だった」 中間選挙控え
item.description:
Gram Slattery Steve Holland
[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery　Steve Holland

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は３０日、１１月の中間選挙を控え、ガソリン価格の高騰が重しとなり支持率が低迷する中、自身の経済実績について説明するのが「非常に下手」だったと述べた。

ホワイトハウスで開催された「ヒスパニック文化遺産月間」の行事で支持者を前に語った。トランプ氏は、共和党が連邦議会の多数派を維持できるかが決まる１１月３日の中間選挙に向け、同党候補を支援する３２日間の集中的な選挙運動を始める予定だ。

トランプ氏は「この国がどれほど好調なのかを説明するのが非常に下手だった」と述べ、「この国はかつてないほど好調だ」と主張した。

しかし、世論調査ではトランプ氏の経済運営を低く評価する有権者が増えている。米経済は、同氏の世界各国に対する関税政策や、エネルギー価格急騰を招いた対イラン戦争によって揺さぶられてきた。

トランプ氏は大統領選挙後の最初の議会選挙では通常、与党が議席を減らすと指摘し、支持者に対し投票に行くよう呼びかけた。

トランプ氏は１０月１日にテキサス、オクラホマ両州を訪問し、２日にアラバマ州、３日にオハイオ州に立ち寄る予定だ。

トランプ氏は、自ら高く評価する経済運営について「われわれは十分に伝えられていない」と指摘。「誰も実績を売り込んでいないので、私が出向く。われわれは宣伝が極めて下手だが、国の運営は極めてうまくやっている。だが、これから伝えていく。難しいことではないはずだ」と語った。

item.title: Falcons agree to 4-year, $78M deal with Gervon Dexter Sr.
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons have agreed to terms on a four-year extension with defensive tackle Gervon Dexter Sr.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Atlanta Falcons have agreed to terms on a four-year extension with defensive tackle Gervon Dexter Sr. The deal is worth $78 million with $46.5 million guaranteed, according to reports. Atlanta obtained the fourth-year pro from the Chicago Bears in August for defensive back Clark Phillips III and a 2027 fifth-round draft pick. "Gervon is a young, ascending talent whose power, disruption and impact along the defensive line are difficult to find," Falcons first-year general manager Ian Cunningham said. "What's been just as impressive is the growth he's shown off the field as a man and a father. "His passion for the game and commitment to his teammates are qualities we value highly, and we're excited to keep him as an important part of our defense moving forward." Dexter has seven tackles and 0.5 sacks through Atlanta's first three games. In his Chicago tenure, Dexter had 115 tackles, 13.5 sacks, 42 quarterback hits and four fumble recoveries in 49 games (33 starts). Dexter, who turns 25 on Oct. 5, was a second-round pick (53 overall) in the 2023 draft. Cunningham was Chicago's assistant general manager at the time. --Field Level Media

item.title: トヨタ、アルゼンチンＥＶ工場に13.4億ドル投資へ
item.description: [３０日 ロイター] - アルゼンチンのカプト経済相は３０日、トヨタ自動車が同国で電気自動車（ＥＶ）生産工場を整備す...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トヨタ、アルゼンチンＥＶ工場に13.4億ドル投資へ 9:03 配信

トヨタのロゴ。2026年1月、インドのムンバイで撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

[３０日 ロイター] - アルゼンチンのカプト経済相は３０日、トヨタ自動車が同国で電気自動車（ＥＶ）生産工場を整備するため１３億４０００万ドルを投資すると発表した。

同国の自動車産業では単一案件として過去最大の投資になるという。

• カプト氏によると、計画地はブエノスアイレス州サラテ。大規模投資奨励制度（ＲＩＧＩ）の申請を審査する政府委員会で承認された。

• 生産台数の約７０％を海外市場向けとし、年間１２億８０００万ドルの輸出を見込む。

• 建設期間中に３６００人超、操業開始後には直接・間接合わせて２６００人超の雇用を創出するという。

• 今回の投資により、トヨタはアルゼンチンでの生産体制を拡充する。同社は１９９７年からサラテで工場を操業。現在はピックアップトラック「ハイラックス」とスポーツ多目的車（ＳＵＶ）「ＳＷ４」を生産しており、２０２４年にはバン「ハイエース」の生産も開始した。

• 自動車各社は世界的に中国からの輸入車との競争が激化する中、中南米への投資を強化している。

• 仏自動車大手ルノーは今月、アルゼンチン北部のコルドバ工場で全ての組み立てを行う新型ピックアップトラックを発表した。

item.title: Pentágono cria comando militar para ampliar capacidades em IA e drones
item.description: O secretário de Defesa dos Estados Unidos, Pete Hegseth, anunciou nesta quarta-feira a criação de um novo comando militar dedicado ao desenvolvimento e ao fornecimento de recursos autônomos e robóticos para todas as Forças Armadas dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O secretário de Defesa dos Estados Unidos, Pete Hegseth, anunciou nesta quarta-feira a criação de um novo comando militar dedicado ao desenvolvimento e ao fornecimento de recursos autônomos e robóticos para todas as Forças Armadas dos EUA. O comando, que segundo Hegseth se chamará “Comando de Guerra Autônoma”, destaca a natureza em rápida transformação da guerra e a necessidade de avançar em sistemas como drones e no uso da inteligência artificial. A criação de um novo comando não é comum -- o último foi o Comando Espacial dos EUA, em 2019 -- e a medida reflete o esforço do Pentágono para migrar de plataformas de armas convencionais, que são caras, para sistemas autônomos mais baratos e baseados em IA, que se mostraram decisivos em conflitos recentes. Diante de centenas de oficiais subalternos e soldados em Quantico, Virgínia, em um discurso repleto de críticas à mídia, Hegseth disse que o comando deve ser liderado por um oficial de quatro estrelas. “O ritmo da guerra está mudando mais rápido do que o processo para apoiá-la”, disse Hegseth em um discurso intitulado “Estado das Forças”, no qual anunciou outras mudanças, incluindo a criação de um escritório de assuntos religiosos. “Computação barata, superinteligência e manufatura comercial avançada possibilitaram a proliferação de ataques de baixo custo e alta precisão”, acrescentou Hegseth. Atualmente, as Forças Armadas dos EUA contam com 11 comandos de combate, responsáveis por diferentes regiões do mundo e tarefas específicas. RISCOS DA IA Especialistas têm manifestado receios quanto ao potencial de um desenvolvimento descontrolado da IA e de rivalidades tecnológicas que poderiam aumentar ainda mais os riscos no ambiente de segurança global. Tanto a China quanto os EUA, os dois principais impulsionadores do desenvolvimento de ponta em IA e de sua adoção global, têm estado em desacordo quanto às políticas e às práticas do setor. Especialistas em segurança dos dois países têm clamado por medidas de proteção e pela construção de um consenso em relação à IA em sistemas militares, incluindo armas nucleares. Os Estados Unidos já contam com seu vasto orçamento militar para colocar em operação alguns dos sistemas de armas mais caros do mundo. Mas há uma percepção crescente dentro do Pentágono de que isso não é sustentável. “Hoje precisamos tanto de qualidade quanto de quantidade”, disse Hegseth. GUERRA NA UCRÂNIA A tecnologia de guerra evoluiu rapidamente nos últimos anos, mudança claramente ilustrada pela guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia. O que começou como um conflito dominado por tanques e artilharia tornou-se, cada vez mais, uma guerra de drones. Em desvantagem em termos de blindados e aeronaves convencionais, a Ucrânia recorreu a sistemas não tripulados de baixo custo para reconhecimento e ataque. Estima-se que os drones sejam responsáveis por cerca de 70% das baixas russas, permitindo que as operações sejam realizadas remotamente e reduzindo o risco para pilotos e tripulações. O Pentágono tem feito alguns avanços nos últimos anos, incluindo a criação de uma força-tarefa -- a Interagências Conjunta 401 -- focada no combate aos drones.

item.title: 英情報機関、中国組織のスパイ支援活動巡り警告 ＡＩ研究などに資金提供
item.description:
Michael Holden
[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Michael Holden

[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英国内の情報収集を担う情報局保安部（ＭＩ５）は３０日、中国の研究機関「中国通用技術研究院（ＣＧＴＲＩ）」が中国当局のスパイ活動のために、人工知能（ＡＩ）などに関する英国の学術研究に資金を提供しているとして、国内の大学や研究者らに異例の警告を発した。

ＭＩ５は「スパイ活動に関する警告」で、英国を拠点とする研究者１００人超が、ＣＧＴＲＩから資金提供を受けた研究に参加していたと指摘。ＣＧＴＲＩについて、中国の情報機関である国家安全省（ＭＳＳ）と「非常に強い関係」があると付け加えた。

さらに「ＣＧＴＲＩの主な目的は、ＭＳＳのスパイ活動に必要な技術能力を直接向上させる学術研究に資金を提供することだと確認した」と説明した。

英国の研究者が、ＡＩやサイバーセキュリティー、秘密通信システム、ステガノグラフィーなどに関するＣＧＴＲＩの資金提供プロジェクトに参加していたとされており、「こうした活動は中国国家安全省のスパイ活動を支援し、英国の国家安全保障に脅威をもたらす」という。ステガノグラフィーはメッセージや物体の中に情報を隠す技術だ。

ＭＩ５が独自にこうした警告を一般向けに公表するのは初めて。中国によるスパイ活動を巡っては英国側から相次いで疑惑が指摘されており、安全保障上の懸念と、対中関係改善を進める英政府の姿勢との間にある緊張を改めて浮き彫りにした。

在英中国大使館は疑惑について「想像上のもので、完全な捏造だ」と反発。大使館の報道官は「根拠のない非難に断固反対し、英国側に厳正な申し入れを行った。英国の情報機関に対し、虚偽の情報を広め、中国と英国の教育交流や研究協力を損なうことをやめるよう求める」と述べた。

一方、ジャービス安全保障担当相は国内の全大学の責任者に書簡を送り、教職員らが中国側の組織との関係を打ち切るよう求めたと明らかにした。

ＭＩ５は、多くの研究者や研究機関が、ＣＧＴＲＩと中国国家安全省との密接な関係を知らず、善意で協力していた可能性があると分析した。その上で、今後も関係を継続すれば、外国によるスパイ活動や敵対的な国家活動への対処を強化するため２０２３年に成立した英国の国家安全保障法に基づき、訴追される恐れがあると注意喚起した。

ジャービス氏は声明で「今回の警告は、中国の情報機関がわれわれの研究者の専門知識や研究成果から秘密裏に利益を得ようとし、英国と同盟国の国家安全保障を損なっている実態を明らかにした。大学や研究機関が発展を続けるためには国際的な連携が不可欠だが、われわれが直面する脅威から国を守るため、断固とした措置を取る」と強調した。

item.title: US says it conducted experiment aimed at improving ability to detect nuclear blast
item.description: The US National Nuclear Security Administration conducted a "subsurface, non-nuclear chemical high-explosive experiment" on Wednesday that the Energy Department said aimed to improve the United States' ability to detect low-yield nuclear explosions.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: The US National Nuclear Security Administration conducted a "subsurface, non-nuclear chemical high-explosive experiment" on Wednesday that the Energy Department said aimed to improve the United States' ability to detect low-yield nuclear explosions. DETAILS: The experiment was focused on improving US capabilities to detect a "decoupled" explosion, the type of test Washington alleged China had conducted in [USN:S8N3VC018 TEXT:"June 2020"] to decrease the effectiveness of seismic monitoring. The United States accused Beijing earlier this year of conducting the secret nuclear test in 2020 as it called for a new, broader arms control treaty. China said at the time that the US allegation was "entirely unfounded" and an attempt "to fabricate excuses for resuming" US nuclear testing. The US National Nuclear Security Administration successfully conducted the experiment at the Nevada National Security Site in the P Tunnel in Area 12, using chemical high-explosives and radiotracers, the Energy Department said in a statement on Wednesday. It added that data collected from the experiment will be used to validate scientific models and refine algorithms critical to US nuclear explosion detection efforts.

item.title: Netanyahu exalta piloto indiano esfaqueado em avião da flydubai
item.description: O primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, elogiou o piloto indiano Smit Machchhar por salvar os passageiros depois que ele foi esfaqueado por um colega em uma suposta tentativa de causar a queda de um avião da flydubai nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Kanjyik Ghosh
item.content:encoded: O primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, elogiou o piloto indiano Smit Machchhar por salvar os passageiros depois que ele foi esfaqueado por um colega em uma suposta tentativa de causar a queda de um avião da flydubai nesta quarta-feira. Os passageiros do voo chegaram a Israel em segurança nesta quarta-feira, depois que passageiros e tripulantes frustraram a tentativa do copiloto de fazer a aeronave cair, informaram autoridades israelenses. A luta começou quando ele esfaqueou o piloto e fez com que o jato despencasse quase 14.000 pés (4.267 m) em menos de 30 segundos. Machchhar estava coberto de sangue no chão quando conseguiu acionar o mecanismo de abertura da porta da cabine de comando, disse um porta-voz de Netanyahu à Reuters. Isso permitiu que passageiros e tripulantes dominassem o copiloto e possibilitou que uma segunda dupla de pilotos da flydubai, que estava a bordo, pousasse o jato em Tabuk, na Arábia Saudita. “Ele salvou a vida de 174 pessoas, incluindo cidadãos israelenses e de outras nacionalidades”, disse Netanyahu em uma postagem no X. “Todos os passageiros estão a salvo”, havia afirmado Netanyahu mais cedo em um comunicado em vídeo divulgado por seu gabinete. Autoridades indianas na Arábia Saudita informaram que Machchhar está recebendo os cuidados médicos necessários em um hospital na cidade de Tabuk, no noroeste do país, e que estão em contato com sua família e com as autoridades sauditas para oferecer toda a ajuda possível. Segundo informações, ele se encontra em estado estável, informou a embaixada indiana na Arábia Saudita em uma postagem no X. Machchhar, que é natural de Mumbai, a capital financeira da Índia, foi submetido a uma cirurgia após o incidente, informou o jornal indiano Hindustan Times. De acordo com seu perfil no LinkedIn, Machchhar trabalhou na companhia aérea indiana SpiceJet (SPJT.BO) por mais de 11 anos antes de ingressar na flydubai. A causa da briga entre os pilotos não ficou clara. A flydubai afirmou em comunicado que as razões por trás do ocorrido permanecem desconhecidas e alertou contra “especulações prematuras”. A companhia também suspendeu os voos de e para Israel enquanto a investigação está em andamento. Netanyahu descreveu o ocorrido como “um incidente de segurança extremamente grave” e afirmou que as autoridades sauditas iriam interrogar o copiloto do voo FZ1073 da flydubai, que estava a caminho dos Emirados Árabes Unidos para Israel.

item.title: フライドバイ機で副操縦士が機長刺す イスラエル人乗客が語る、恐怖の急降下と緊迫の攻防
item.description: アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）のドバイからイスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていた格安航空「フライドバイ」のFZ1073便で、副操縦士が機長を刺した後、機体を墜落させようとした事件があった。乗務員と乗客らが副操縦士を取り押さえ、他の操縦士がサウジアラビアのタブーク空港に無事着陸させたという。イスラエル人乗客が、その当時の機内の様子を語った。機体が突然急降下し、20―30秒間激しい揺れに見舞われた後、前方で騒動が起きているのが見え、大勢の乗客が殺到したという。着陸したサウジでは温かいお茶や食事なども提供されたといい、この乗客は「パニックが起きることもなく、皆終始落ち着いていた」と話した。

item.title: フライドバイ機長、刺され出血もドア開錠 乗客ら174人救う
item.description:
Kanjyik Ghosh
[３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kanjyik Ghosh

[３０日 ロイター] - アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のドバイからイスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたフライドバイ機内で副操縦士が機長を刺した事件で、イスラエル政府は３０日、インド人操縦士が出血して床に倒れながらも、操縦室のドアを開ける解除ボタンを何とか押したと明らかにした。

副操縦士はその後、乗客と乗員に取り押さえられ、旅客機は乗り合わせたフライドバイの操縦士２人によってサウジアラビア北西部のタブークに無事着陸した。イスラエル当局は、副操縦士が機長を刺して旅客機を墜落させようとしていたと説明しているが、詳しい動機は分かっていない。

イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は、刺されながらも乗客を救ったインド人操縦士スミット・マッチャル氏を称賛。Ｘへの投稿で「彼はイスラエル国民や他国の人々を含む１７４人の命を救った」と述べた。

インド当局によると、マッチャル氏はタブークの病院で治療を受けている。在サウジのインド大使館はＸへの投稿で、同氏の容体は安定していると報告を受けたと明らかにした。

インド紙ヒンドゥスタン・タイムズによると、マッチャル氏は事件後に手術を受けたという。

フライドバイは声明で、事件の根本的な原因は依然不明だとし、「早まった憶測」を控えるよう求めた。また、調査が進められる中、イスラエル発着便の運航を停止した。

ネタニヤフ氏は「治安上、極めて深刻な事件」だとし、副操縦士をサウジ当局が取り調べると述べた。

item.title: Paramount recebe aprovação judicial para acordo com Warner Bros e nomeia Kreiz, da Mattel, como co-CEO
item.description: Um juiz dos EUA emitiu uma ordem nesta quarta-feira permitindo que a Paramount conclua sua aquisição da Warner Bros. por US$110 bilhões, pondo fim a um impasse que durava meses, ao mesmo tempo em que a empresa nomeou Ynon Kreiz, da Mattel, como co-CEO para ajudar a administrar os negócios combinados.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um juiz dos EUA emitiu uma ordem nesta quarta-feira permitindo que a Paramount (PSKY.O) conclua (WBD.O) sua aquisição da Warner Bros. por US$110 bilhões, pondo fim a um impasse que durava meses, ao mesmo tempo em que a empresa nomeou Ynon Kreiz, da Mattel, como co-CEO para ajudar a administrar os negócios combinados. A juíza do Tribunal Distrital dos Estados Unidos, Araceli Martínez-Olguín, aprovou em 21 de setembro um acordo com um grupo liderado pela Califórnia, composto por 12 estados, que havia entrado com uma ação judicial para bloquear uma das maiores fusões de mídia da história, alegando que ela criaria um gigante da mídia capaz de aumentar os preços de filmes e programas de TV. Nos termos do acordo, a empresa resultante da fusão deverá lançar pelo menos 30 filmes por ano nos cinemas dos EUA durante cinco anos e investir US$300 milhões adicionais por ano em produções nos EUA. O não cumprimento dessa meta poderá forçá-la a vender a Miramax. Também deverá negociar separadamente os contratos de TV a cabo para os canais das duas empresas e criar um conselho de jornalistas para supervisionar a CBS News e a CNN. Grupos contrários à fusão protestaram veementemente contra o acordo, e alguns chegaram a instar o tribunal a rejeitá-lo. Martínez-Olguín classificou o acordo como uma "solução factual e jurídica razoável", afirmando que as expectativas dos opositores de que o decreto "alcance mais longe – alcance mais – não chegam ao nível de violações legais" que justifiquem sua rejeição. Um porta-voz do Departamento de Justiça da Califórnia afirmou que o acordo "resolve nossas preocupações antitruste, protege a concorrência e a escolha do consumidor e prioriza as necessidades, preocupações e o futuro dos trabalhadores da Califórnia". As empresas afirmaram em um comunicado divulgado na noite de quarta-feira que a conclusão do negócio está prevista para 6 de outubro. As empresas também chegaram a um acordo em um processo antitruste movido pelo Sindicato dos Roteiristas da América (WGA), concordando em pagar US$ 17,5 milhões ao fundo de saúde do sindicato e manter os níveis de pessoal do WGA na CBS News por cinco anos. KREIZ DA MATTEL SE TORNARÁ CO-CEO Em comunicado separado, a Paramount informou que o presidente-executivo da Mattel, Ynon Kreiz, se juntará à empresa em 5 de outubro e se tornará co-CEO quando o negócio for concluído, ao lado do presidente e presidente-executivo David Ellison, responsável pelas operações diárias e pela integração. Kreiz, presidente-executivo da Mattel desde 2018, transformou as marcas da fabricante de brinquedos em filmes, programas de TV e jogos, entregando "Barbie", o filme de maior bilheteria da Warner Bros. A contratação proporciona a Ellison, cuja experiência é na área criativa, um profissional experiente que conduziu a Mattel durante a pandemia e as tarifas, enquanto a Paramount busca economizar mais de US$6 bilhões com a fusão. Antes de trabalhar na Mattel, ele passou grande parte de sua carreira na TV e na mídia digital, sendo cofundador da Fox Kids Europe e diretor da Endemol, produtora do programa "Big Brother". Mais tarde, ele dirigiu a rede do YouTube Maker Studios, que vendeu para a Disney em 2014. (Por Jody Godoy, Akash Sriram e Arasu Kannagi Basil)

item.title: Australia's Lynas Rare Earths to buy Meteoric Resources in $672 million deal
item.description: Australia's Lynas Rare Earths said on Thursday it would acquire Meteoric Resources in an all-share deal valuing the Perth-based miner at A$968 million ($672 million).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's Lynas Rare Earths (LYC.AX) said on Thursday it would acquire Meteoric Resources (MEI.AX) in an all-share deal valuing the Perth-based miner at A$968 million ($672 million). Under the scheme of arrangement, Lynas will acquire all Meteoric shares at a fixed exchange ratio of 0.0207 new Lynas shares for each Meteoric share, an over 68% premium as of Meteoric's last close. The deal gives the world's biggest producer of rare earths outside China access to Meteoric's flagship Caldeira Rare Earth Project in Brazil. Lynas said it intends to work with Meteoric's existing team to advance development of Caldeira and expects capital expenditure for the development of the project to be over $500 million. The firm has also pledged to provide Meteoric with an interim funding facility of up to A$110 million to fund the continued development of the Caldeira project. Meteoric's board has unanimously recommended the scheme in the absence of a superior proposal and subject to an independent expert concluding the transaction is in the best interests of shareholders. The acquisition comes as the rare earths producer said in late August it planned [USN:L4N44N063 TEXT:"to grow its global supply chain"] and secure new mine supply from project developers around the world. ($1 = 1.4403 Australian dollars)

item.title: Australiana Lynas Rare Earths comprará Meteoric Resources em acordo de US$672 mi
item.description: A australiana Lynas Rare Earths anunciou nesta quarta-feira que iria adquirir a Meteoric Resources em um acordo de troca de ações que avalia a desenvolvedora de terras raras em US$672,08 milhões.

item.content:encoded: A australiana Lynas Rare Earths (LYC.AX) anunciou nesta quarta-feira que iria adquirir a Meteoric Resources (MEI.AX) em um acordo de troca de ações que avalia a desenvolvedora de terras raras em US$672,08 milhões. Nos termos do acordo, a Lynas adquirirá todas as ações da Meteoric a uma taxa de câmbio fixa de 0,0207 novas ações da Lynas para cada ação da Meteoric. (Por Roshan Thomas)

item.title: 「シャイニーハンターズ」のサイトが停止、ＦＢＩへの要求期限切れ後
item.description:
AJ Vicens
[３０日 ロイター] - 米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）捜査官数千人の個人情報などを盗み出したと主張するハッカー集団「シャイニーハンターズ」のウェブサイトが３０日、アクセスできなくなった。同集団はＦＢＩに対し、集団の手口や過去の活動に関する声明を撤回または修正するよう期限を設けて要求していたが、その期限が前日に切れていた。
• シャイニーハンターズは世界の大手企業を標的にしてきた。９月２２日にロイターなどの報道機関に対し、「ほぼ全てのＦＢＩ捜査官と、ＦＢＩの採用に応募した人々に関する」データを盗んだと主張した。
• ロイターがその後、同集団から提供されたデータのサンプルを分析したところ、個人を特定できる広範な情報や、機微な職務情報、精神科を含む医療情報が含まれていることが分かった。
•
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
AJ Vicens

[３０日 ロイター] - 米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）捜査官数千人の個人情報などを盗み出したと主張するハッカー集団「シャイニーハンターズ」のウェブサイトが３０日、アクセスできなくなった。同集団はＦＢＩに対し、集団の手口や過去の活動に関する声明を撤回または修正するよう期限を設けて要求していたが、その期限が前日に切れていた。

• シャイニーハンターズは世界の大手企業を標的にしてきた。９月２２日にロイターなどの報道機関に対し、「ほぼ全てのＦＢＩ捜査官と、ＦＢＩの採用に応募した人々に関する」データを盗んだと主張した。

• ロイターがその後、同集団から提供されたデータのサンプルを分析したところ、個人を特定できる広範な情報や、機微な職務情報、精神科を含む医療情報が含まれていることが分かった。

• ロイターはサイトにアクセスできなくなった理由を確認できなかった。シャイニーハンターズとは連絡が取れず、コメントを得られなかった。

• シャイニーハンターズは、ＦＢＩが今年５月に同集団について出した注意喚起が過去の活動を誤って伝えていると考え、報復措置としてＦＢＩを標的にしたと説明。注意喚起を「修正するか、削除する」よう求め、１週間の期限を設けていた。

• 注意喚起は現在もオンライン上で公開されている。シャイニーハンターズはその後、盗んだデータを公開する意図はなく、目的を達成したと述べた。

• ＦＢＩは９月２３日、情報流出について「積極的かつ精力的に捜査している」と表明した。３０日には、同集団のサイトを強制的に停止させる措置を取ったかどうかについてコメントを控えた。

• オランダ警察は今週、シャイニーハンターズに関する捜査に関連し、９月１５日にオランダ人の男を逮捕したと発表した。

item.title: UAE発イスラエル行き旅客機、副操縦士が機長を刺し墜落を図ったか 約4300メートル急降下 乗客らが襲撃者を制圧
item.description:
ドバイ発テルアビブ行きの旅客機が30日、サウジアラビアに緊急着陸した。イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は、フライドバイ機の副操縦士が機長を刺した後、機体を墜落させようとしたが、乗客が制止したと明らかにした。
◇
ロイター アレクサンダー・コーンウェル記者
現時点で分かっているのは、アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）発イスラエル行きの民間旅客機内で30日、操縦士の1人がもう1人の操縦士を刺して、機体を墜落させようとしたとみられることだ。この事案を受けて、機体はサウジアラビアに緊急着陸した。
このテルアビブ行きの機内では、乗客らが襲撃者を制圧したとされている。イスラエル当局者はこの襲撃者をオマーン国籍だと確認している。その後、たまたま同機に搭乗していた同じ航空会社所属の別の操縦士らが操縦を引き継いだ。
イスラエルメディアで広く報じられている機内の映像には、血のついた服を身に着けた乗客の姿が映っている。同機には170人を超える乗客が搭乗
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドバイ発テルアビブ行きの旅客機が30日、サウジアラビアに緊急着陸した。イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は、フライドバイ機の副操縦士が機長を刺した後、機体を墜落させようとしたが、乗客が制止したと明らかにした。

◇

ロイター　アレクサンダー・コーンウェル記者

現時点で分かっているのは、アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）発イスラエル行きの民間旅客機内で30日、操縦士の1人がもう1人の操縦士を刺して、機体を墜落させようとしたとみられることだ。この事案を受けて、機体はサウジアラビアに緊急着陸した。

このテルアビブ行きの機内では、乗客らが襲撃者を制圧したとされている。イスラエル当局者はこの襲撃者をオマーン国籍だと確認している。その後、たまたま同機に搭乗していた同じ航空会社所属の別の操縦士らが操縦を引き継いだ。

イスラエルメディアで広く報じられている機内の映像には、血のついた服を身に着けた乗客の姿が映っている。同機には170人を超える乗客が搭乗しており、その大半はイスラエル国民とされている。

イスラエル首相府のドロン・シュピールマン報道官が私に語ったところによると、襲われた操縦士がドアの解錠を助けたことで、乗客らが操縦室を制圧できたという。

乗客らが操縦室に入った際、襲撃者が操縦装置に覆いかぶさるように立ち、それを損傷、あるいは破壊しようとしていたとみられる。フライトレーダー24によると、事案の最中、機体は数秒間で約1万4000フィート（約4300メートル）急降下した。

もう一つの注目点は、機体がイスラエルと国交のないサウジアラビアに着陸したことだ。イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相によると、襲撃者はサウジ当局に拘束され、取り調べを受けている。一方、動機については現時点で明らかにされていない。

item.title: 数回の小幅利上げでハイパースケーラー投資は鈍化せず＝ミネアポリス連銀総裁
item.description: [ニューヨーク ３０日 ロイター] - 米ミネアポリス地区連銀のカシュカリ総裁は３０日、数回の小幅な利上げがハイテク...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
数回の小幅利上げでハイパースケーラー投資は鈍化せず＝ミネアポリス連銀総裁 8:36 配信

ミネアポリス地区連銀のカシュカリ総裁。2023年5月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Segar

[ニューヨーク ３０日 ロイター] - 米ミネアポリス地区連銀のカシュカリ総裁は３０日、数回の小幅な利上げがハイテクセクターへの投資を大幅に鈍化させる可能性は低いとの見解を示した。

同氏はニューヨークの外交問題評議会の会合で「最大３回の２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが、ハイパースケーラー企業の成長をどれほど鈍化させるだろうか。大したことはない」と語った。

ハイテク投資を対象とした利上げについては「これが良い投資か悪い投資かについて、私が後知恵で『自分の方がよく分かっている』と断言する立場にはない」と述べ、人工知能（ＡＩ）への投資が金融システムにシステミックリスクをもたらすとは考えていないと語った。

item.title: Quase 1.000 crianças foram vítimas de abuso em três dioceses de Massachusetts, segundo apuração de inquérito estadual
item.description: Mais de 270 clérigos católicos abusaram sexualmente de quase 1.000 crianças em três dioceses de Massachusetts ao longo de décadas, de acordo com um relatório investigativo divulgado nesta quarta-feira pela procuradora-geral do Estado.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: Mais de 270 clérigos católicos abusaram sexualmente de quase 1.000 crianças em três dioceses de Massachusetts ao longo de décadas, de acordo com um relatório investigativo divulgado nesta quarta-feira pela procuradora-geral do Estado. O relatório apresentou o que a procuradora-geral de Massachusetts, Andrea Joy Campbell, chamou de primeiro relato público completo dos abusos e das falhas institucionais que permitiram que eles se proliferassem por mais de meio século nas dioceses católicas de Fall River, Springfield e Worcester. A maioria dos abusos detalhados no relatório ocorreu antes de 2002, ano em que o escândalo de abuso sexual por clérigos ganhou destaque internacional devido a uma reportagem do Boston Globe — vencedora do Prêmio Pulitzer — sobre como autoridades da Arquidiocese Católica Romana de Boston encobriam rotineiramente os abusos sexuais cometidos por padres. A investigação da procuradora-geral do Estado documentou anos de problemas semelhantes nas três dioceses em outras partes de Massachusetts, que, segundo Campbell, sabiam que crianças estavam sendo abusadas por padres e outros clérigos. “Com muita frequência, elas protegeram a reputação da Igreja em vez de proteger as crianças”, disse Campbell. O relatório contabilizou pelo menos 275 membros do clero acusados de abusar de 944 crianças. “Por trás de cada um desses números está uma criança cuja segurança foi violada, uma família que mudou para sempre e um sobrevivente que carregou o trauma desse abuso por anos e, em muitos casos, décadas”, disse Campbell aos repórteres. A Diocese de Worcester, em comunicado, afirmou que analisaria o relatório “para identificar quaisquer melhorias adicionais que possam ser feitas para atender às vítimas de abusos passados e para continuar a fortalecer os esforços para garantir a segurança das crianças”. O bispo de Fall River, Edgar da Cunha, emitiu um pedido de desculpas aos sobreviventes de abuso sexual infantil, dizendo que estava “cheio de tristeza diante do relato histórico de incidentes e práticas que refletem as trágicas falhas na proteção dos mais vulneráveis”. O bispo de Springfield, William Byrne, em comunicado, classificou o relatório como “humilhante”. Ele disse que, antes de sua divulgação, sua diocese já estava “ocupada corrigindo nossas falhas passadas, implementando muitas políticas e procedimentos novos e baseados na abordagem do trauma”. A reportagem de 2002 do Boston Globe, que mais tarde foi retratada no filme “Spotlight”, vencedor do Oscar em 2015, desencadeou uma onda global de investigações que revelaram padrões semelhantes em dioceses em todo o mundo e levou a Assembleia Legislativa de Massachusetts a aprovar uma série de reformas. Em 2019, a então procuradora-geral Maura Healey, hoje governadora de Massachusetts, iniciou uma investigação criminal nas dioceses católicas romanas de Fall River, Springfield e Worcester para determinar se elas ou suas lideranças tinham responsabilidade em relação à supervisão de clérigos que abusaram de crianças. Campbell, que afirmou ter sido ela própria vítima de abuso infantil nas mãos de um parente, disse que seu gabinete encaminhou três casos aos promotores públicos locais durante a investigação, o que resultou em acusações em um caso em Worcester. Seu gabinete não deu andamento a nenhum processo judicial porque algumas condutas não eram ilegais na época em que ocorreram ou porque o prazo de prescrição já havia expirado, disse ela. Campbell afirmou que o relatório demonstrou a necessidade de as dioceses instituírem reformas e de novas leis estaduais que apoiem sobreviventes de abuso, incluindo a eliminação do prazo de prescrição para ações civis envolvendo abuso sexual infantil.

item.title: トランプ氏、政治犯釈放巡り習主席と「重要な議論」
item.description:
Gram Slattery Kanishka Singh
[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery　Kanishka Singh

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は３０日、先週行われた中国の習近平国家主席との会談で、政治犯の釈放について協議したと明らかにした。

トランプ氏は記者団から、６月に中国当局に拘束されたミャンマー出身の米国籍学者ミンジン氏や、民主派香港紙「蘋果日報（リンゴ日報）」の創業者で中国への批判で知られる黎智英氏ら政治犯の問題を取り上げたかと問われ、「習主席と話した」と述べた。

さらに「非常に重要な議論ができたと思う。実り多い議論だったことを願う」と語った。

ホワイトハウスは習氏の訪米に先立ち、トランプ氏が中国で不当に拘束されている人々の問題を取り上げる見通しだと説明していた。

item.title: Netanyahu hails stabbed Indian pilot of flydubai plane
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu hailed Indian pilot Smit Machchhar for saving passengers after he was stabbed by his colleague in an alleged attempt to crash a flydubai plane on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Kanjyik Ghosh
item.content:encoded: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu hailed Indian pilot Smit Machchhar for saving passengers after he was stabbed by his colleague in an alleged attempt to crash a flydubai plane on Wednesday. Passengers on the flight [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"reached"] Israel safely on Wednesday after customers and crew foiled the co-pilot's attempt to crash the aircraft, Israeli officials said. The struggle began when he stabbed the pilot and sent the jet plunging nearly 14,000 feet (4,267 m) in less than 30 seconds. Machchhar was covered with blood on the floor when he managed to click the release to open the cockpit door, a Netanyahu spokesperson told Reuters. That allowed passengers and crew to overpower the co-pilot and enable a second pair of flydubai pilots who were on board to land the jet in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. "He saved the lives of 174 people, including Israeli citizens and other nationals," Netanyahu said in a post on X. "All passengers are out of harm's way," Netanyahu had earlier said in a video statement released by his office. Indian authorities in Saudi Arabia said Machchhar is receiving necessary medical attention in a hospital in the northwestern city of Tabuk and they are in touch with his family and Saudi authorities to extend all possible help. He is reported to be stable, the Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia said in a post on X. Machchhar, who hails from India's financial capital Mumbai, underwent surgery after the incident, Indian newspaper the Hindustan Times reported. According to his LinkedIn profile, Machchhar worked with India's SpiceJet (SPJT.BO) airline for over 11 years before joining flydubai. The cause of the altercation between the pilots was not clear. Flydubai said in a statement that the underlying reasons for the event remained unknown and warned against "premature speculation." It also [USN:S8N45108H TEXT:"suspended"] flights to and from Israel amid an investigation. Netanyahu described the event as "a highly severe security incident", and said Saudi authorities would interrogate the co-pilot of flydubai FZ1073, which had been en route from the United Arab Emirates to Israel.

item.title: Esther Rantzen, campaigning British television presenter, dies aged 86
item.description: Esther Rantzen, the British television presenter whose show "That's Life!" made her a weekly fixture in living rooms of the 1970s and 1980s, and who was a prominent supporter of a campaign for Britain to legalise assisted dying, died on Wednesday aged 86.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Young
item.content:encoded: Esther Rantzen, the British television presenter whose show "That's Life!" made her a weekly fixture in living rooms of the 1970s and 1980s, and who was a prominent supporter of a campaign for Britain to legalise assisted dying, died on Wednesday aged 86. Diagnosed with terminal lung cancer in her early 80s, Rantzen returned to the media spotlight in 2023 to lend her support to the assisted dying movement. She praised the "huge positive difference" the End of Life bill would make when the House of Commons voted in favour of it in June 2025. It was to be the final crusade of her life, one that followed numerous other successful campaigns. With Rantzen at the helm, "That's Life!" was credited with helping to make car seat belts compulsory for children, bringing in safer surfaces to replace concrete in playgrounds, and encouraging more people to sign up for organ donation. Running from 1973 to 1994 on the BBC, the programme regularly drew audiences of 15 to 20 million people. Rantzen's death was announced by her family in a statement published by the BBC on Wednesday. She had said in September 2026 that she was now "too physically fragile" to travel, preventing her from ending her life at an assisted dying clinic in Switzerland. 'MAKING A DIFFERENCE IS ADDICTIVE' Rantzen's show shone a spotlight on issues like stillbirth, addiction and mental health, at a time when they were not frequently discussed. "Making a difference is addictive, so when so many people contacted me about assisted dying when I mentioned my concern about the current law, I could hardly let them down, could I?" she said of the role she played in her final campaign. She said that out of the deaths in quick succession of her husband, mother and dog, it was Marmite the dog's that she envied. He was put to sleep after his breakfast and walk. In November 2025, she said she had stopped receiving treatment for cancer. Her long-held plan had been to travel to the Dignitas clinic in Switzerland for an assisted death. "My great hope for 2026, which I do not expect to survive long enough to witness, is the final passing of the Assisted Dying Bill through all its stages in parliament," she wrote in The Times newspaper. Assisted dying, which would mark one of the biggest social changes in a generation in Britain, was [USN:L1N4530IL TEXT:"rejected by parliament earlier this month"]. Her involvement came after decades of championing other causes. In 1986, she founded Childline, a free, confidential helpline for children and young people in distress. That came after she dedicated an episode of her show to child abuse, causing a temporary helpline to be swamped with calls. The charity has since helped hundreds of thousands of people, and its model has been replicated around the world. She later had the idea of a helpline for the elderly. It took encouragement from the late Queen Elizabeth II for Rantzen to realise that ambition. She launched The Silver Line in 2012. 'THE EMOTION STOPPED ME' Elizabeth had been one of the millions who watched "That's Life!", said Rantzen, who in the 1980s was one of Britain's most influential broadcasters. Beyond the light entertainment, "That's Life!" told true-life stories. One of the most famous was the story of Nicholas Winton, the British stockbroker who in 1939 helped 669 children, most of them Jewish, flee German-occupied Czechoslovakia for Britain. Winton's efforts went unrecognised for almost 50 years until he appeared on the programme. In a television moment still remembered decades later, Winton was told that some of those he had saved were sitting by him in the studio audience. "It was the only time in my professional life when, as a presenter, the emotion stopped me," Rantzen later said. "I had to break off our recording, leave my chair and take a moment to wipe my eyes." She married Desmond Wilcox, a television producer, in 1977. They had three children: Emily, Rebecca and Joshua. Wilcox died of a heart attack in 2000. She was haunted by the trauma of seeing doctors repeatedly trying to save him when she knew he had already gone. "The last thing I want is for my family to remember me in pain," she said. Born in 1940 into a Jewish family in Hertfordshire, north of London, her earliest memory was of standing in her cot listening to the wail of the air-raid sirens. Her first ambition was to be a schoolteacher, but her headmistress persuaded her to do something else first. She studied English at Oxford, before joining the BBC to work on sound effects. Her father also worked at the public broadcaster, as an electrical engineer. In November 2025, she wrote that she was planning to celebrate Christmas early, to improve the odds of being alive for the occasion. "Although I live alone, Rebecca will come and decorate the house beautifully, as she has done every year with all my old baubles and bits of tinsel," she wrote. "Which reminds me, I must ask her to buy a Christmas tree for me." For more obituaries, click here .

item.title: Red Sox replace injured Roman Anthony on roster with Curtis Mead
item.description: The Boston Red Sox replaced injured outfielder Roman Anthony on their wild-card series roster with infielder Curtis Mead on Wednesday ahead of Game 2 against the New York Yankees.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Boston Red Sox replaced injured outfielder Roman Anthony on their wild-card series roster with infielder Curtis Mead on Wednesday ahead of Game 2 against the New York Yankees. Anthony underwent imaging in Boston on Wednesday morning that displayed he had "additional damage to some muscles" in his right hand and wrist, Red Sox manager Chad Tracy said prior to Game 2 of the American League series. Anthony had an injury to the same hand earlier this season that caused him to miss nearly four months. He returned to action Aug. 30. "I've been experiencing some things with the swings and the check swings over the past six weeks," Anthony said on Wednesday. "Last night just felt a little bit more intense, a little bit more worse than past swings that have been lingering a little bit longer than the ones I was used to. "It was just super alarming and it got to a point where it was tough to grip a bat," Anthony added. "I knew then and there that this was a little bit more similar to the one earlier in the year. That's why we decided to go get imaging." Major League Baseball approved the roster change after reviewing the medical information. Anthony will be ineligible to return if the Red Sox reach the AL Division Series, but he will be eligible to play if Boston advances to the AL Championship Series. Anthony started Tuesday's 9-0 loss in Game 1 batting leadoff as the designated hitter and struck out in both at-bats -- on check swings -- against New York's Cam Schlittler. The hand injury flared up and he couldn't continue. Anthony was replaced by Andruw Monasterio in the sixth inning. Tracy was unsure if the 22-year-old Anthony might require hand surgery. "I don't know the answer to that yet," Tracy said. "I just know that the imaging shows more than what was originally there. So as far as what treatment plans are in the future, haven't gotten there. "Just midday today I first found out, yeah, there's more there that we're not going to have him. We'll figure it out as we move along." Anthony batted .245 with five homers and 15 RBIs in 55 games. "After I came back, the hand was never really fully a hundred percent," Anthony said. "For me, it was to a point where it was tolerable and I was taking certain swings that were sketchy and I was still able to come back and recover enough to just be in there every single day, but, ultimately, I just took a few swings here recently where that wasn't the case." Mead was acquired from the Washington Nationals a few days ahead of the trade deadline and sustained a broken left wrist in his first game with the team. He was hit by a pitch from Athletics right-hander Jack Perkins in the fourth inning of his debut on July 27. Mead, 25, hit .254 with 17 homers, 17 doubles and 48 RBIs -- all career highs - in 87 games with the Nationals before the trade. --Field Level Media

item.title: Swiss glaciers lose more than 5% of ice after record heatwave
item.description: Swiss glaciers are shrinking rapidly after suffering one of their worst years of ice loss during a record-breaking European heatwave.
item.dc:creator: Cecile Mantovani, Denis Balibouse
item.content:encoded: Swiss glaciers are shrinking rapidly after suffering one of their worst years of ice loss during a record-breaking European heatwave. Switzerland's glaciers lost more than 5% of their ice in 2026, a report by the Swiss Glacier Monitoring Network (GLAMOS) and the Swiss Commission for Cryosphere Observation of the Swiss Academy of Sciences showed on Thursday. The findings underscore the accelerating pace of glacier retreat as extreme melt years become routine. Over the past five years, Swiss glaciers have shed almost a fifth of their ice, the report showed, threatening future water supplies and raising questions about the long-term survival of Europe's ice fields. "Now we are in this new world, in this future, where glaciers are just melting away," Matthias Huss, director of GLAMOS, said. A combination of a winter with too little snow and record temperatures in the summer led to what Huss called "enormous" melting this year. 'A REALLY WORRYING SITUATION' "We are seeing extreme years almost every year now and this is really a worrying situation," Huss said. Still, the rate of ice loss has not yet quite reached the record highs of 2022, when dust clouds from North Africa settled on the snow and accelerated melting, Huss said. Switzerland's largest glacier, Aletsch Glacier, suffered its biggest-ever melt this year, while Glacier de Tsanfleuron lost more than four meters (13 feet) of average thickness. Huss said this would have been unthinkable a few years ago. In total, the scientists estimate Swiss glaciers lost around 2.2 trillion litres of water between July and September alone, equivalent to more than four times the annual drinking water consumption of Swiss households. That has one positive side effect: glacier melt contributes to easing summer water shortages. But, as ice-covered areas shrink and glaciers become smaller, this benefit is decreasing, Huss said. "It's not that we're surprised because we know how fast the glaciers are melting, but to see the colours of the mountains where there is no snow left, there are just these rocks," Huss said. "It makes me sad."

item.title: インフレはなお高すぎ、追加利上げを予想＝ミネアポリス連銀総裁
item.description: [ニューヨーク ３０日 ロイター] - 米ミネアポリス地区連銀のカシュカリ総裁は３０日、インフレ率を目標に戻すために極め...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インフレはなお高すぎ、追加利上げを予想＝ミネアポリス連銀総裁 8:01 配信

写真は米ミネアポリス地区連銀のカシュカリ総裁。2023年5月、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Segar

[ニューヨーク ３０日 ロイター] - 米ミネアポリス地区連銀のカシュカリ総裁は３０日、インフレ率を目標に戻すために極めて必要な取り組みが続く中、経済動向次第で連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が再び利上げすると予想していると述べた。

ニューヨークの外交問題評議会で行った講演で、９月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で追加利上げの見通しが示されたことについて「あの会合が開かれた水曜日時点で入手していた情報に基づく、その時点でのスナップショットだ」と述べた。

また「インフレデータに関する私の基本的な受け止めは、インフレは依然として高すぎるということだ」とし、直近のデータもこの見方を変えるものではないと述べた。

さらに、１０年以上の連銀総裁の在任期間に触れ、「最初の５年間に、インフレが高止まりする状況に５年間も耐えることがあるかと聞かれたら、絶対にない、そんなことが起きるはずはないと答えただろう。それでも今、われわれはそうした状況にある」と語った。

ただ、「金融政策は機能し得ると分かっている」と述べ、インフレ率を目標に戻すことができるとの認識を示した。

２９日には、ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁が年内の利上げを見込むとしつつ、９月のＦＯＭＣで利上げした後、現時点で追加引き締めを急ぐ必要はないとの見解を示したことを受け、市場の利上げ観測は後退していた。

ＦＲＢが利上げを進める中、債券利回りも急上昇している。理論上はこれが景気の抑制につながり、インフレを抑えるＦＲＢの取り組みを後押しする可能性がある。ＦＲＢ当局者はこうした利回り上昇について、景気見通しへの楽観、旺盛な人工知能（ＡＩ）投資を背景とした資金争奪、エネルギー市場を混乱させている中東情勢を巡る不透明感が要因だと指摘している。

カシュカリ氏は「市場が発している信号をやみくもに退けたくない。市場は今、政策金利をわれわれの想定以上に引き締める必要があるかもしれないと示唆している」と指摘。「注視はしたいが、盲目的に追随したいわけでもない。市場がそう判断する背景にはさまざまな要因があるからだ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず アングル：米企業、金利上昇で借り換え負担増大　コロナ禍調達分の満期相次ぐ コラム：米利上げでアジア株式市場に明暗、経常赤字国の打撃大きく コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 10/1(木) 9:15 ロイター

item.title: Fed's Kashkari says central bank must lower inflation pressures
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis President Neel Kashkari said on Wednesday that he expects the central bank to raise rates again depending on how the economy performs, amid a very necessary effort to bring inflation back to target.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis President Neel Kashkari said on Wednesday that he expects the central bank to raise rates again depending on how the economy performs, amid a very necessary effort to bring inflation back to target. Penciling more interest rate hikes as part of the September Federal Open Market Committee meeting forecasts “is a snapshot in time based on information we had on that Wednesday of the meeting,” Kashkari said at an appearance before the Council on Foreign Relations in New York. “My basic takeaway on the inflation data is that inflation is still too high” and the latest round of data doesn’t change that story, he said. Kashkari added that in more than a decade at the Fed, "If you'd asked me in my first five years, would we ever endure five years of elevated inflation? I would have said, not a chance. There's no way that could happen, and yet here we are." But he added, "I know monetary policy can work" and that it can bring inflation back to target. On Tuesday, market expectations for the future of interest rate increases downshifted after New York Fed leader [USN:L6N45L165 TEXT:"John Williams"] said that while he sees an increase happening before the end of the year, he believes there is no urgency to tighten at the moment after hiking rates at the September 15-16 FOMC meeting. Then, officials lifted the overnight target rate by a quarter percentage point to between 3.75% and 4% in a bid to help temper inflation pressures that have now overshot the central bank's 2% target for over five years. Fed officials also believe robust overall growth numbers and labor market stability give them space to focus on their inflation challenge. At the September meeting where rates were hiked, officials also penciled in one more increase before the end of the year. But financial markets had been expecting a more aggressive path of tightening before Williams' comments on Tuesday. As the Fed has been hiking rates, bond yields have also been spiking, which could in theory help create restraint on the economy and assist the Fed in its efforts to lower the rise in inflation. Fed officials have tied those gains to optimism over the economic outlook, competition for capital amid strong artificial intelligence investment and uncertainty over the Middle East war that’s roiled energy markets. "I don't want to blindly dismiss what markets are signaling because markets right now are signaling that policy may have to go even tighter than we expect," Kashkari said. "I want to pay attention to it, but I don't want to blindly follow it either because there are a lot of different factors that can go into some of these market judgments," he said.

item.title: A visual retrospective of America's two decades in Iraq
item.content:encoded:
A U.S. soldier watches as a statue of Iraq's President Saddam Hussein falls in central Baghdad April 9, 2003. U.S. troops pulled down a 20-foot (six metre) high statue of President Saddam Hussein in central Baghdad on Wednesday and Iraqis danced on it in contempt for the man who ruled them with an iron grip for 24 years. In scenes reminiscent of the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989, Iraqis earlier took a sledgehammer to the marble plinth under the statue of Saddam. Youths had placed a noose around the statue's neck and attached the rope to a U.S. armoured recovery vehicle. PP03040026 Pictures of the month April 2003 REUTERS/Goran Tomasevic

GOTGoran TomasevicReuters
